metaDescription: Kevin examines reports that 11 NSA and US Cyber Command personnel died by suicide in a year around Fort Meade, plus the four-day NSANet outage.
summary: This video covers Bloomberg-cited reports that at least 11 people working for the NSA and US Cyber Command died by suicide in the 12 months ending in September, 10 of them at Fort Meade. Kevin links the deaths to NSA leadership turnover, DOGE-era staff cuts, a heavier workload, and a mental health budget he says was left off a funding request. He also discusses the nearly four-day NSANet outage that began November 17, which he finds suspicious. Kevin says he doubts the official personal and financial explanations and asks viewers with information to contact him.

keyMoments.label: 11 Suicides at NSA and Cyber Command
